message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: 'CI'

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request: ~
  workflow_dispatch: ~

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v3
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
      - name: get composer cache directory
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "::set-output name=dir::$(composer config cache-files-dir)"
      - name: cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-lint-composer-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-lint-composer-
      - name: install dependencies
        run: just install
      - name: lint
        run: just lint
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        phpversion: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v3
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.phpversion }}
          coverage: xdebug
      - name: get composer cache directory
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "::set-output name=dir::$(composer config cache-files-dir)"
      - name: cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.phpversion }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.phpversion }}-composer-
      # roave/security-advisories conflicts with every PHP 8.1 release (8.1 is EOL), so drop it on 8.1 only
      - name: remove roave/security-advisories on PHP 8.1
        if: matrix.phpversion == '8.1'
        run: composer remove --dev --no-update --no-interaction roave/security-advisories
      - name: install dependencies
        run: just install
      - name: test with phpunit on ${{ matrix.phpversion }}
        run: EASYPOST_TEST_API_KEY=123 EASYPOST_PROD_API_KEY=123 just coverage
      - name: Coverage
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@fb8b3582c8e4def4969c97caa2f19720cb33a72f # v7.0.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
  docs:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v3
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
      - name: get composer cache directory
        id: composer-cache
        run: echo "::set-output name=dir::$(composer config cache-files-dir)"
      - name: cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-docs-composer-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-docs-composer-
      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: just install
      - name: Generate Docs
        run: just docs
      - name: Deploy Docs
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: docs",
  "rationale": "Applied P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads): the run-tests job already caches Composer dependencies keyed on composer.lock and runner/PHP context, but the lint and docs jobs run `just install` with no dependency cache. Adding the same Composer cache step to lint and docs reuses downloaded dependencies across repeated runs while preserving every existing build, test, lint, and docs step unchanged. The cache key includes the lockfile hash, satisfying the pattern precondition, and actions/cache@v5 is already used in the workflow, so no new privileged actions, secrets, or network operations are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
